text:
You also need a bowl, tray or bucket to act as the pool. You don’t need to put water in it. Place all five frogs onto the log next to the pool.

Sing the song together with your child. Every time a frog jumps into the pool in the song, ask your child to move a frog off the log and into the bowl or tray.

You could ask your child 'what is one less than...?' as you go along.

text: Cut out the log and frogs from the template.

Five Speckled Frogs

Five little speckled frogs

Sat on a speckled log

Eating some most delicious bugs.

YUM! YUM!

One jumped into the pool, (move a frog into the pool)

Where it was nice and cool,

Now there are four green speckled frogs!



Four little speckled frogs

Sat on a speckled log

Eating some most delicious bugs.

YUM! YUM!

One jumped into the pool, (move a frog into the pool)

Where it was nice and cool,

Now there are three green speckled frogs!



Three little speckled frogs

Sat on a speckled log

Eating some most delicious bugs.

YUM! YUM!

One jumped into the pool, (move a frog into the pool)

Where it was nice and cool,

Now there are two green speckled frogs!



Two little speckled frogs,

Sat on a speckled log,

Eating some most delicious bugs.

YUM! YUM!

One jumped into the pool, (move a frog into the pool)

Where it was nice and cool,

Now there is one green speckled frog!



One little speckled frog,

Sat on a speckled log,

Eating some most delicious bugs.

YUM! YUM!

They jumped into the pool, (move the last frog into the pool)

Where it was nice and cool,

Now there are no green speckled frogs!
